# Azure Provisioning Verified ID client library for .NET

Azure.Provisioning.VerifiedId simplifies declarative resource provisioning for Microsoft Entra Verified ID in .NET.

## Getting started

### Install the package

Install the client library for .NET with [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/):

```dotnetcli
dotnet add package Azure.Provisioning.VerifiedId --prerelease
```

### Prerequisites

> You must have an [Azure subscription](https://azure.microsoft.com/free/dotnet/).

### Authenticate the Client

## Key concepts

This library allows you to specify your infrastructure in a declarative style using .NET. You can then use azd to deploy your infrastructure to Azure directly without needing to write or maintain Bicep or ARM templates.

## Examples

### Create a Verified ID authority

This example demonstrates how to create a Microsoft Entra Verified ID authority.

```C# Snippet:VerifiedIdAuthorityBasic
Infrastructure infra = new();

VerifiedIdAuthority authority =
    new(nameof(authority), VerifiedIdAuthority.ResourceVersions.V2024_01_26_PREVIEW)
    {
        Tags = { ["environment"] = "test" },
    };
infra.Add(authority);
```
